$comment: Bugs already known and already owned, so the adversary reports them as `status: "known"`
instead of burying a real new finding under noise.
EVERY ENTRY EXPIRES. `expires` is an ISO date; past it, the entry stops muting and the
finding is promoted back to `status: "new"` with a note saying the entry lapsed. That is
the whole point — without expiry this file quietly becomes a permanent mute button, and a
bug nobody fixed reads forever as a bug somebody is fixing.
invariant  (required) an id from lib/invariants.mjs — checked, so a typo fails the run
why        (required) plain-language reason this is already known
ref        (required) the plan or handoff that owns the fix
expires    (required) ISO date. The phase boundary by which it should be fixed

entries.why: Inventory.drop() removes from `held` only. The item stays in the satchel and never lands in the world, so a drop can read as a duplication. Roc logged this in the 2026-08-23 review notes; it is Group 1, and the fix spans phaser/src/world/Inventory.ts and tools/lantern/src/lib/play.ts together.
Same root cause as the drop bug above: the satchel-drop/move track is mid-rework, so the pocket array and its compaction can disagree while Group 1 is in flight.
